title: llama-roofline: a portable memory-bandwidth roofline for llama.cpp
description:
A command-line tool that answers one question about a local LLM setup: is token generation limited by memory bandwidth? It measures the machine's sustainable memory-read bandwidth with a portable microbenchmark, benchmarks the user's own GGUF models through llama-bench across a thread sweep, fits the decode roofline tok/s = BW_eff / model_bytes, and prints a plain-English report card with the bandwidth utilisation, the size/quantization frontier, and the thread count beyond which decode stops improving.

Outputs a roofline figure, a Markdown report, and machine-readable JSON. Pure standard library at its core; numpy and matplotlib are optional extras.
